text:
marco: Quick sync: we need to lock Phase 1 scope for routing/segmentation. Trying to avoid scope creep from named-customer asks.

tia: Agreed. Minimal P1 should include soft affinity, per-route QoS toggle, and basic telemetry. Hard pins can be an addon.

hana: Ops caution: soft affinity still needs eviction story and a backpressure signal to protect other tenants.

marco: What are simple rollout gates we can all live with?

eli: Propose: 1) Canary across 2 customers for 72h with perf within targets, 2) rollback automation verified, 3) billing SKU defined for QoS.

marco: OK, add an acceptance test for quality: run a 50-prompt eval set before/after routing switch and detect >2% regression => fail.

devops-bot: Scheduled job created: segmentation-loadtest (link: https://r.wd/jobs/seg-load).

tia: UX: console should show cost delta estimate when enabling QoS. Small mock due tomorrow.

hana: I'll build eviction runbook and the noisy-tenant harness.

marco: Final: owners: Hana -> infra tests, Tia -> UX & billing mock, Eli -> rollout automation. I'll draft RFC and tag reviewers. Flag blockers here within 24h.
